Liberal M.L.A. Harry Blank and Montreal City Councillor 
Ferdinand Allie will participate in the official opening of 
a poly!lingual day care centre at 4:00 p.m. Friday, February 26. 

The centre, a joint undertaking of the Montreal YMCA 
and the Family Services Association, ts housed In a former 
residence for Jesuit Teaching Brothers, 

Located at 5561 Jeanne Mance, it Is at the hub of a 
how-income area with a heavy concentration of Greek immigrants 
to Canada. 

It will accomodate 47 pre-school children, many of them 
from fami !lles where both parents must work to provide the 
necessities for survival. 

All members of the staff are fluent in at lteast two 
languages--Greek and English or French. 

This trilingual aspect of the project will pave the way 
for the youngsters’ entry Into Canadian society and, at the 
same time, give them an Insight into the tanguage and culture 


of their parents.
